corrections.location: systemd.exec(5), stable heading SANDBOXING > ProtectSystem=, first definition paragraph; page footer systemd 262.1; native HTML reopened 2026-10-20
corrections.quote: Takes a boolean argument or the special values "full" or "strict".
corrections.replacement: Positive definition only: the reopened revision defines ProtectSystem= as taking a boolean argument or the special values "full" and "strict", and that sentence is the documented argument domain this pair relies on. full adds /etc/ to the mounts made read-only by true; strict mounts the file system hierarchy read-only except the API file system subtrees /dev/, /proc/ and /sys/. No exhaustive parser or undocumented-value claim is made, and this pair does not assert an exhaustive absence.
